evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics are triage evidence about whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the multimodal patient geometry. For both K2_C0001 and K2_C0002, the dominant spectral gap occurs at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1) with a large leading eigengap and much smaller subsequent gaps; this describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and does not show a dominant internal multi-cluster subdivision signal. Within-set mean fused affinities are low and nearly identical across the two sets, and the nearest-pair between-set affinity is similarly low, so the current pair boundary is not sharply expressed in fused affinity geometry. These observations concern representation and boundary structure only; they do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity, and they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge. No reclustering was performed, and no feasible k>=2 internal solutions were produced at this partition scope, so internal-subdivision evidence is not available here.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0001 shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition. The dominant program is up-regulated oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.29, q=0.001), accompanied by coordinated up-regulation of reactive oxygen species, mTORC1, MYC targets, glycolysis, DNA repair, and cell-cycle (G2M) programs, and by down-regulation of UV-response-DN, TGF-beta, Hedgehog, and Wnt beta-catenin signaling. A second coherent axis is immune/inflammatory: interferon gamma and alpha responses, allograft rejection, complement, IL6-JAK-STAT3, and inflammatory response are all up-enriched with overlapping interferon-stimulated and HLA-related leading-edge genes. This pattern describes a metabolically active, immune/inflammatory-high molecular phenotype. Per the evidence role, this biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For K2_C0001, current-label alignment in each native modality geometry is weak: silhouettes are near zero in CT (0.013) and small in RNA (0.079), WSI (0.050), and WXS (0.091), with mean between-label distances only marginally exceeding mean within-label distances in every modality. This indicates limited geometric support for treating K2_C0001 membership as a separately represented unit in these native geometries. The global geometry concordance (GRV) values describe overall shared structure between modality geometries and are not themselves current-boundary support; they range from low (CT-RNA 0.092, WSI-WXS 0.092, CT-WXS 0.103) to modest (RNA-WXS 0.145, CT-WSI 0.167, WSI-RNA 0.198), with permutation p=0.001 for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, and WSI-RNA, and nonsignificant p for CT-RNA (0.071) and CT-WXS (0.218) and WSI-WXS (0.096). Because the partition contains exactly two sets, the K2_C0001-versus-rest contrast is the reciprocal description of the K2_C0002-versus-rest contrast and is not an independent confirmation. No reclustering was performed.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior structural_diagnostics report for this partition described weak within-set fused affinity and no dominant internal subdivision signal, and noted the boundary between K2_C0001 and K2_C0002 was not sharply expressed in fused affinity geometry. The present set-scope alignment results are consistent with that picture: current-label separation is weak across native modalities. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0002 shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype that is largely the reciprocal of K2_C0001. Its dominant feature is down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation (NES -2.29, q=0.001), with coordinated down-regulation of reactive oxygen species, mTORC1, MYC targets, glycolysis, DNA repair, E2F/G2M cell-cycle, and immune/inflammatory programs (interferon alpha/gamma, allograft rejection, complement, IL6-JAK-STAT3, inflammatory response). Conversely, UV-response-DN, TGF-beta, Hedgehog, and Wnt beta-catenin signaling are up-enriched. This describes a metabolically lower, immune/inflammatory-low molecular phenotype relative to the rest of the partition. Per the evidence role, this biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior biological_support report was supplied for this round. limitations: The contrast is a single set-versus-rest comparison; with exactly two sets, the two reciprocal contrasts are not independent confirmations.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For K2_C0001, current-label alignment in each native modality geometry is weak: silhouettes are near zero in CT (0.013) and small in RNA (0.079), WSI (0.050), and WXS (0.091), with mean between-label distances only marginally exceeding mean within-label distances in every modality. This indicates limited geometric support for treating K2_C0001 membership as a separately represented unit in these native geometries. The global geometry concordance (GRV) values describe overall shared structure between modality geometries and are not themselves current-boundary support; they range from low (CT-RNA 0.092, WSI-WXS 0.092, CT-WXS 0.103) to modest (RNA-WXS 0.145, CT-WSI 0.167, WSI-RNA 0.198), with permutation p=0.001 for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, and WSI-RNA, and nonsignificant p for CT-RNA (0.071) and CT-WXS (0.218) and WSI-WXS (0.096). evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the candidate pair K2_C0001 versus K2_C0002, current-label alignment in each native modality geometry is weak: silhouettes are near zero in CT (0.013) and small in RNA (0.079), WSI (0.050), and WXS (0.091), with mean between-label distances only marginally exceeding mean within-label distances in every modality. This indicates limited geometric support for the current pair boundary being expressed as a distinct separation in these native geometries. The global geometry concordance (GRV) values describe overall shared structure between modality geometries and are not themselves current-boundary support; they range from low (CT-RNA 0.092, WSI-WXS 0.092, CT-WXS 0.103) to modest (RNA-WXS 0.145, CT-WSI 0.167, WSI-RNA 0.198), with permutation p=0.001 for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, and WSI-RNA, and nonsignificant p for CT-RNA (0.071), CT-WXS (0.218), and WSI-WXS (0.096). No reclustering was performed, so no internal-subdivision solution is evaluated here.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior structural_diagnostics report for this partition described weak within-set fused affinity and no dominant internal subdivision signal, and noted the boundary between K2_C0001 and K2_C0002 was not sharply expressed in fused affinity geometry. The present pair-scope alignment results are consistent with that picture: current-label separation is weak across native modalities. The biological_support reports describe a coherent reciprocal molecular phenotype between the two sets, but that is a different dimension and does not convert weak geometric alignment into boundary support.
limitations: Current-label alignment is weak across all modalities, so this result provides limited geometric support for the current pair boundary being expressed in native patient geometry.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0001 shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition. The dominant program is up-regulated oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.29, q=0.001), accompanied by coordinated up-regulation of reactive oxygen species, mTORC1, MYC targets, glycolysis, DNA repair, and cell-cycle (G2M) programs, and by down-regulation of UV-response-DN, TGF-beta, Hedgehog, and Wnt beta-catenin signaling. A second coherent axis is immune/inflammatory: interferon gamma and alpha responses, allograft rejection, complement, IL6-JAK-STAT3, and inflammatory response are all up-enriched with overlapping interferon-stimulated and HLA-related leading-edge genes. This pattern describes a metabolically active, immune/inflammatory-high molecular phenotype. Per the evidence role, this biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0001 exhibits a coherent, interpretable mutation phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by marked VHL depletion (18/55 versus 38/48; OR 0.13, q_global 0.012) together with PBRM1 depletion and BAP1 enrichment. This pattern of low VHL and low PBRM1 with BAP1 enrichment is a recognizable ccRCC-associated molecular configuration and is internally coherent across the prespecified driver panel. The VHL signal is the only one surviving global multiplicity adjustment; PBRM1 and BAP1 are significant only within the driver panel. Per the evidence role, this biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: Prior biological_support reports for this round described K2_C0001 as a metabolically active, immune/inflammatory-high RNA phenotype (oxidative phosphorylation, interferon, mTORC1, MYC, glycolysis up). The prior cross_modal_consistency reports described weak geometric alignment for K2_C0001 membership, which is a different dimension and does not bear on this mutation phenotype.
limitations: The driver panel is a post-hoc prespecified ccRCC annotation, not a discovery feature-selection criterion.
Only VHL survives global multiplicity adjustment; PBRM1 and BAP1 are significant only within the driver panel and should not be read as globally significant.
BAP1 enrichment rests on 0/48 rest events with a Haldane-Anscombe correction, producing a very wide interval and unstable magnitude.
CDKN2A is not estimable (no events in either group), which is neither support nor contradiction.

Several factors show statistically supported association with candidate membership: tissue source site (strongest, Cramer's V 0.43, q=0.009), CT phase (V 0.32, q=0.028), CT scanner model (V 0.31, q=0.028), CT slice thickness (epsilon-squared 0.066, q=0.026), and CT z-spacing (epsilon-squared 0.048, q=0.028). These indicate a partition-wide technical concern: measured site and acquisition factors are imbalanced across the two candidates and remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed partition structure. CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel, pixel spacing, and study year show no statistically supported association. Association is not causation, and these partition-level results describe the partition as a whole; they do not establish that any particular candidate has a candidate-specific confounder association, and no covariate adjustment or causal control was performed. Nonsignificance for the remaining factors does not establish absence of confounding.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, this analysis tests whether the current two-set partition as a whole is associated with measured technical, acquisition, or site factors. Several factors show statistically supported association with candidate membership: tissue source site (strongest, Cramer's V 0.43, q=0.009), CT phase (V 0.32, q=0.028), CT scanner model (V 0.31, q=0.028), CT slice thickness (epsilon-squared 0.066, q=0.026), and CT z-spacing (epsilon-squared 0.048, q=0.028). These indicate a partition-wide technical concern: measured site and acquisition factors are imbalanced across the two candidates and remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed partition structure. CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel, pixel spacing, and study year show no statistically supported association. Association is not causation, and these partition-level results describe the partition as a whole; they do not establish that any particular candidate has a candidate-specific confounder association, and no covariate adjustment or causal control was performed. Nonsignificance for the remaining factors does not establish absence of confounding.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior confounder_exclusion report was supplied for this round. The prior biological_support reports described coherent reciprocal molecular phenotypes; those are separate dimensions and are not addressed by this confounder analysis.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be promoted to a candidate-specific confounder claim without set-scope evidence.

Nonsignificant factors (CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel, pixel spacing, study year) are not evidence of absence of confounding.

The dominant program is up-regulated oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.29, q=0.001), accompanied by coordinated up-regulation of reactive oxygen species, mTORC1, MYC targets, glycolysis, DNA repair, and cell-cycle (G2M) programs, and by down-regulation of UV-response-DN, TGF-beta, Hedgehog, and Wnt beta-catenin signaling. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, this analysis tests whether the current two-set partition as a whole is associated with measured technical, acquisition, or site factors. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At pair scope, the boundary measurements and the union structure answer different questions. The boundary measurements describe the current labels: boundary silhouette is essentially zero (0.0003) and mean between-set fused affinity (0.00902) is essentially equal to pooled within-set affinity (0.00932), so the current K2_C0001/K2_C0002 boundary is not sharply expressed in fused affinity geometry. Per the scope guidance, a weak current boundary together with a single-cluster-dominated union is structurally compatible with removing the boundary and must never be interpreted as evidence against merge, but is not sufficient by itself to justify merge. These observations concern representation and boundary structure only; they do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity, and they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge. No reclustering was performed, and no feasible k>=2 internal solutions were produced at this pair scope, so internal-subdivision evidence is not available here.
